note: Hand-authored. One verdict per extracted feature, after reading the frozen page text and, where the quote was ambiguous, the live site. true = the venue really has it; false = it does not, or the quote does not mean what the feature means; uncertain = the site says something adjacent but a customer filtering on this feature could reasonably be disappointed.

verdicts.why: Happy-hour menu is restricted to 'Bar and Outside Patio Only', which only makes sense if a patio exists.
Sunday brunch 9am-2pm, stated outright.
The model's quote ('family atmosphere') is weak marketing, but the menu carries a Charritos kids meal and a FAMILY & GROUP section. Right answer, wrong evidence.
Dedicated banquet and special-events pages.
'Beautiful outdoor patio' in the venue's own copy.
PRIVATE PARTIES is a nav section.
'Reserve the Cantina for Your Event' with a booking link.
Names eleven games including shuffleboard, darts and pop-a-shot.
Karaoke Thursday to Saturday at 8:30pm.
PATIO is one of the four named spaces.
Open to 2am Thursday to Saturday.
Brunch is a menu in the nav.
Private Events is a nav section.
Fri/Sat close at 12am. Midnight is not past midnight, and every other night closes at 10 or 11.
Live music happens only at member-only parties every other month. A customer filtering for live music cannot walk in and find it.
One of the owners is the event coordinator and the contact form takes event bookings.
Trivia Tuesdays 6:30-9pm.
The quoted '1:00 pm - 12:00 am' is an events-calendar entry for the happy hour, not the venue's closing time.
'Want TJ Oyster Bar At Your next event?' is the Catering nav item. Catering is offsite; the venue advertises no private dining.
Bambini Menu is a kids menu.
The model quoted the catering line, but the site has a Banquets section. Right answer, wrong evidence.
Open 11am-12am daily. Closing at midnight is not a late-night venue.
Parties nav plus a groups-and-parties booking page.
The site's own title is 'Live music venue in San Diego, CA'.
The venue sits inside Mission Bay Beach Club, on the bay, and the site says so.
Sunset Trivia is a Mission Bay Beach Club event with drinks from Moonlight Bar. Attaching it to the coffee and juice counter inside the club is a provenance error the model could not detect.
'bocce in the vineyard' on a Mission Bay site is copy of unclear provenance. There is no vineyard at Mission Bay.
The model quoted breakfast/lunch/dinner, which does not support brunch, but the site's own cafe tags read 'Breakfast and Brunch'. Right answer, wrong evidence.
Explicit event-venue pitch for birthdays and corporate functions.
'We are a family restaurant founded in 1995' describes the ownership, not kids catering. No kids menu anywhere on the site.
The venue is called Carlotta Brunch.
The line sits directly under Windmill Canyon on the Camp Pendleton restaurants page, not under a sibling venue.
Filipino brunch is the headline offer.
Karaoke Thursdays.
Rotating live music and DJ nights.
Private party room rentals.
Horton Plaza parking validations, priced.
Open to 1am.
The only evidence is a republished Yelp review by a customer. The venue itself makes no such claim, and a review is not a policy.
